def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    # Generic xorshift solver.
    # Try to read parameters from inputs, else fall back to defaults from problem 1.
    X = int(inputs.get('X', inputs.get('x', 32586213)))
    n = int(inputs.get('iterations', inputs.get('n', inputs.get('repeat', 14))))
    a = int(inputs.get('shift1', 11))
    b = int(inputs.get('shift2', 9))
    c = int(inputs.get('shift3', 17))
    mask = 0xFFFFFFFF
    for _ in range(n):
        X ^= (X << a) & mask
        X ^= (X >> b)
        X ^= (X << c) & mask
        X &= mask
    return float(X)
